verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a SaaS experimentation platform, so the axis applies. The pack only documents Scheduled Rollouts, which are a time-staged rollout of a single feature gate rather than a recurring job or workflow schedule. It also shows CLI use inside CI/CD pipelines, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. No first-party recurring scheduler is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
